rust_summary: whether one player sees another (`native_player_visible_to`): vanish levels, per-viewer hides and spectators, as the tracker applies them.
doc_summary: `native_player_visible_to(viewer, target)` tells whether the player `viewer` sees the player `target` now, by the rules their clients track players with: spectators seen only by spectators (and not while watching a camera), a vanished player seen from its level up (`native_hide_player`), and a player hidden from the viewer (`native_hide_entity_from`) not seen. Read-only; false when either is not on. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_visible_to@.
